scripts.build: npm run api-docs && npm run ensure_index_file_is_on_size_limit
scripts.api-build-spec: npm run update-paths-and-schemas && npm run tsc && node ./build/buildApiSpec.js && swagger-cli validate docs/build/api-docs-output.yaml
scripts.api-docs-export-page: redoc-cli build docs/build/api-docs-output.yaml --title 'Devopness API Docs' --output public/index.html --cdn true -t docs/template.hbs
scripts.api-docs-make-description-files: for endpoint in $(find docs/spec/auto-generated/endpoints -type f); do touch -a docs/spec/descriptions/$(basename ${endpoint%%.yaml}).md; done
scripts.api-docs-serve: npm run api-build-spec && redoc-cli serve docs/build/api-docs-output.yaml --port 9090 --title 'Devopness API Docs - Local' -t docs/template.hbs
scripts.api-docs: npm run api-build-spec && npm run api-convert-spec-to-dredd && npm run api-docs-export-page && npm run api-test
scripts.api-test: npm run tsc && npm run test && npm run remove-descriptions && dredd
